info.title: Kanban Board API
info.description: Kanban board backend API with Better Auth and Socket.IO

tags.name: Agent API
tags.description: Endpoints for agents to interact with projects and tasks. Agents authenticate using API keys with 'ag_' prefix. Permissions are controlled via delegation levels (VIEWER/USER).

post.summary: Sign up new user (alias for register)

columns.description: Initial columns to create for the project

get.summary: Get tasks for project or all accessible tasks
get.description: With projectId: get tasks for a specific project. Without projectId: get all tasks the user has access to (My Tasks)

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: Project ID (optional - if omitted, returns all accessible tasks)

parameters.name: assigneeIds
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of user IDs to filter by assignee

relationId.description: Related task ID for task relations
Related task ID for task relations

patch.description: Alternate endpoint for adding comments to tasks, used by frontend

get.summary: Check if user can be invited

post.description: Create a new delegation allowing an agent to access a specific project with defined permissions. Requires USER or ADMIN role.

projectId.description: The project ID to delegate access to

409.description: Delegation already exists for this agent and project

get.description: Retrieve all delegations for a specific agent, including project details. Requires USER or ADMIN role.

patch.description: Update the permission level for an existing agent delegation. Requires USER or ADMIN role and project membership.

delete.description: Revoke an agent's access to a project by soft-deleting the delegation. Requires USER or ADMIN role and project membership.

get.description: Returns projects accessible to the authenticated agent or user. Agents see projects they've been delegated to with their permission levels. Users see their own projects with their roles.
Returns all tasks in the specified project. Requires VIEW_TASKS permission for agents (VIEWER level).

403.description: Access denied - agent lacks VIEW_TASKS permission for this project

post.description: Creates a new task in the specified project. Requires CREATE_TASK permission for agents (USER level).

403.description: Access denied - agent lacks CREATE_TASK permission (requires USER level)

patch.description: Updates an existing task. Requires UPDATE_TASK permission for agents (USER level).

403.description: Access denied - agent lacks UPDATE_TASK permission (requires USER level)

delete.description: Moves the task to the Agent Review column instead of hard deleting. Adds a comment noting the agent flagged it for review. Requires DELETE_TASK permission for agents (USER level).

403.description: Access denied - agent lacks DELETE_TASK permission (requires USER level)

500.description: Failed to move task to review column

post.description: Adds a comment to the specified task. Requires ADD_COMMENT permission for agents (USER level).

403.description: Access denied - agent lacks ADD_COMMENT permission (requires USER level)

get.description: Retrieve all users with their roles. Requires admin role.

agentAuth.description: Agent API key authentication. Use 'Bearer ag_xxx' format where 'ag_' prefix identifies agent keys. Agents must have active delegations to access projects.
